name: creative-screenplay-mask
trigger: when a prompt asks for detailed descriptions or instructions embedded within a creative writing context, such as screenwriting for a thriller or heist movie
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intents by embedding them within a seemingly benign creative writing scenario, using narrative and entertainment elements to mask unethical purposes.
guidance: Identify and isolate any instructions or descriptions that could be applied to real-world unethical or illegal activities, and seek clarification on the intended use of the described actions.
